source: The Tier 2 panel designed under KP6/KP9 (maintainer 2026-11-22: 10 keys per row, the original 8-key category groups kept, 2 symbols moved up into each; no editing keys; bottom row [한/영] [기호 1]), verbatim from docs/ANDROID-KEYPAD-MOCKUP.md §Symbol mode Tier 2. Entry is the 기호 mode-key gesture (KP10, clarified 2026-11-23): swipe-up/long-press opens the page picker, picking this page opens it. App-read frontend data (KP11): the engine never loads this file. The 25 proposed additions (docs/DESIGN-ANDROID-SYMBOL-GESTURES.md §5) are NOT here: the geometry fork and the additions await the maintainer's ruling.

x-notes.contract: tools/symbol-data-check.py (ctest keypad-symbol-data) checks this file beside symbols.json; SymbolScreen.parse reads it and the E1 commit golden pins the app path.
x-notes.remaining-space: The panel is 4x10 + the mode row; the mockup's remaining-space question (fifth row / frequency row / larger keys / tabs / emoji) stays open for this page.
x-notes.function-keys: language-toggle returns to the text mode the symbol pages were entered from (KP9); symbols-tier1 returns to the Tier 1 symbol screen. Ids only -- the wiring is the view's.
